title: U.S. plans to name Nvidia among AI ‘national champions’, WSJ reports
summary: Investing.com-- The Trump administration plans to designate more than two dozen companies, including Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), OpenAI and Anthropic, as artificial intelligence "national champions" to help them expand overseas and compete with Chinese technology firms, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday.

title: Stocks extend losses as traders digest Nvidia fallout
summary: Asian stocks mostly fell Monday as the tech sector struggled to recover from the crisis at Nvidia after boss Jensen Huang stepped down, with the company's earnings this week and market debut of Anthropic keeping the AI trade in focus.Nvidia is due to report its earnings Tuesday, giving a fresh view on the outlook for the AI trade, while the listing of Anthropic -- creator of the Claude chatbot -- will provide some insight into investors' sentiment.
